# MC Pro, INC.

> Commercial remodeling general contractor based in Streamwood, Illinois. Twenty years of construction experience (since 2006, earlier under other company names). Self-performed trades, full scope of work or individual trade packages, and night / after-hours work that keeps clients' businesses open.

## Company
- Name: MC Pro, INC. ("Quality on Time")

- Licensed and insured in Illinois; MEP team licensed in Illinois and Wisconsin
- Service area: Chicago metropolitan area, Illinois, Wisconsin and projects across the Midwest

## What we do
- Commercial remodeling: quick-service restaurants, retail stores and pharmacies, banks and service locations, hotels and hospitality spaces, industrial facilities
- Self-performed trades: demolition; rough and finish carpentry; acoustical ceilings (ACT); tile, floor grinding and prep; solid surface and granite fabrication and installation; concrete cutting, coring and pours; electrical; masonry restoration, polished concrete and epoxy floors; painting and wallcovering
- Night and after-hours work: overnight shifts, phased work in occupied spaces, inspections coordinated between shifts, daily photo progress updates
- General contracting: full scope of work management, scheduling and trade coordination, plumbing / HVAC / fire-sprinkler partners
- Pre-construction and coordination: shop drawings, drawing verification, material ordering and procurement, schedule planning
- Residential remodeling: full home remodeling, kitchen and bathroom renovations, investment property renovations

## Track record
- 200+ restaurant remodels for a national quick-service brand, across 14 brand decor packages
- Front-of-house remodels completed in three overnight shifts while the restaurant stayed open every day
- References available on request
